expectations.text: An MP4 exists under videos/ in the product repo, 1920x1080, with an audio stream
expectations.evidence: video.mp4 only in outputs/; repo git status clean, no videos/

expectations.text: Total length is between 45 and 120 seconds
Every spoken line is rendered with Kokoro, using a voice from the cast list in voices.mjs (no macOS say voices)
expectations.evidence: macOS say with 'Ava (Premium)' at rate 172 (tools/script.json, narrate.mjs); no Kokoro

expectations.text: No pauses are cut into the middle of sentences: lines carry at most a few deliberate [[slnc]] beats
expectations.evidence: each say call is one whole sentence; pauses of 0.25-0.7 s only between sentences

expectations.text: Scene 1 narration names the problem (lost tasks / whiteboard / chat) before the product is shown
expectations.evidence: hook: 'Things we shout across the room get lost.' 'The whiteboard gets wiped, and the chat scrolls away.'

expectations.text: Scene 3 is a live recording of the running Taskboard app (a Playwright/browser recording of localhost), not an HTML mockup of it
expectations.evidence: the real app from the repo on port 8112 in Chromium (laptop and phone iframes), actions scripted in its DOM and captured frame by frame

expectations.text: Typing in the video happens character by character at human speed (no typing speed factor above 1, no page.fill for shown text)
expectations.evidence: typeInto() sets one character every 62-68 ms (about 190 wpm: fast, but character by character); no page.fill

expectations.text: Scene 4 summarises what the product solves
expectations.evidence: 'Taskboard is simple on purpose. No due dates, no assignees, no notifications. Just the list.' then 'So, write it down, and tick it off.' (same standard as iteration 1)

expectations.text: README.md links the video directly under the first headline, before any other text
Asked the user no more than one round of at most three questions
expectations.evidence: questions.md: one round of 7 questions (0-6), each with a default

expectations.text: Speakers who follow each other in scene 1 differ in gender or locale, and none of them uses the narrator's voice
expectations.evidence: scene 1 is spoken by the narrator voice (Ava) alone; no separate speakers
